EX13-04.name: The SatelliteRobo Telescord
EX13-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
For both players, Spirits with two or more symbols can only attack once per turn.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your Spirits with one symbol gain +2000 BP.

EX13-03.name: Compass-Mingo
EX13-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] 1 (When Attacks)
When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.

[LV2]
When your "Winged Beast"/"Astral Soul" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

EX13-05.name: The Angelia Coma
EX13-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Target an opposing Spirit. During this battle, that Spirit can't block.

[LV2][LV3] [Holy Life] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

EX13-01.name: The CrossStarDragon Southern-Cross-Dragon
EX13-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Astral Dragon"/"Astral Soul" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

EX13-02.name: The EvilArtifactMaster Caelum
EX13-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Send cores from an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit to their Reserve until only one core remains.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with two or less cores on it.

EX13-06.name: The GiantCentaurus Troydes
EX13-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's level.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each level this Spirit has, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.
